shared.missingInfo: The administrator of this instance has not yet stated who the controller is or how to contact them. Until those details are provided, open sign-up is disabled.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: What data this orgtable instance stores, what for and for how long.

summary.heading: In short
summary.body: This instance stores what it needs for you to have an account and for your boards to work. There are no ads, no analytics and no tracking cookies: only technical cookies, for your session and your language. You can download or delete your data yourself from <link>Settings › Privacy and data</link>.

controller.heading: Data controller
controller.body: The controller is whoever operates this instance, not the author of the software. orgtable is open source and anyone can host their own: each instance has its own controller.

data.heading: What data is stored and why

account.data: Name, email, the password hashed with bcrypt (never in plain text) and the interface language
account.purpose: Your account: signing in, being recognised on shared boards and seeing the app in your language
account.basis: Performance of the service you request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR)

acceptance.data: The date on which you accepted this policy and the terms
acceptance.purpose: Being able to prove that you accepted them when you signed up
acceptance.basis: Legitimate interest in being able to prove that you accepted them (Art. 6(1)(f))

content.data: Your boards, lists, cards, labels, checklists, comments, assignments and attachments

notifications.purpose: Letting you know about changes to your boards and about due dates

sessions.data: Sessions: browser (user agent), start date and expiry date
sessions.purpose: Keeping you signed in and letting you end sessions remotely

tokens.data: API tokens: name, visible prefix and their hash (never the token itself)
tokens.purpose: Letting you use the API with your own scripts

audit.dataWithIp: Security log: sign-ins and sign-outs, failed attempts and changes to accounts and permissions, with the IP address
audit.dataWithoutIp: Security log: sign-ins and sign-outs, failed attempts and changes to accounts and permissions (this instance does not store the IP address)
audit.basis: Legitimate interest in keeping the service secure (Art. 6(1)(f))

data.noProfiling: Your data is not used for advertising, no profiles are built and no automated decisions are made about you, and it is not sold or passed on to anyone.

retention.heading: How long it is kept
retention.account: Your account and your content: until you delete them or delete your account.

endedSessions.one: Ended or expired sessions are deleted after {count} day.
endedSessions.other: Ended or expired sessions are deleted after {count} days.

audit.one: The security log is deleted after {count} day.
audit.other: The security log is deleted after {count} days.

backupsDays.one: Backups: they are kept for {count} day. Whatever you delete disappears from the backups when they expire.
backupsDays.other: Backups: they are kept for {count} days. Whatever you delete disappears from the backups when they expire.

retention.backupsNone: Backups: this instance does not make backups.

recipients.heading: Who else can see your data
recipients.boardMembers: The people you share a board with see your name and email, and what you write on that board.
recipients.admin: Whoever administers the instance sees the list of accounts (name, email, role) and the security log. They cannot see your password.
recipients.hosting: The hosting provider stores the data on behalf of the controller, as a processor: {hosting}.
recipients.outsideEea: If the data is hosted outside the European Economic Area, the controller must state so above and apply the safeguards of Chapter V of the GDPR.

cookies.heading: Cookies and browser storage
cookies.body: Two technical cookies: session, essential to keep you signed in, and locale, which remembers the language you choose. Your theme preference (light or dark) is stored in your browser's local storage and never leaves it. Details in the cookie policy.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.intro: You can exercise them yourself, without asking anyone for permission:
rights.access: Access and portability: download all your data as JSON from Settings › Privacy and data.
rights.rectification: Rectification: change your name and your email in Settings › Profile.
rights.erasure: Erasure: delete your account from Settings › Privacy and data. This deletes your account, the boards you created (with their cards and attachments), your comments and your notifications. Other people's boards remain, without you.
rights.objection: Objection and restriction: write to the controller's contact.
rights.complaint: If you believe your rights have not been respected, you can lodge a complaint with the data protection authority. In Spain, that is the <link>Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD)</link>.

security.heading: Security
security.body: Passwords are stored with bcrypt, sessions can be revoked instantly and API tokens are stored as a hash. Sign-in attempts are rate-limited to slow down brute-force attacks.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If the controller's details change, the “last updated” date above changes with them. Changes to what the software stores are published in its <link>source code</link>.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.metaDescription: Terms for using this orgtable instance.

provider.heading: Who provides the service
provider.body: This orgtable instance is operated by {operator}. orgtable is open-source software ({license}); its author does not provide this service and is not liable for it, unless they are also the one operating the instance.

service.heading: The service
service.body: Kanban boards to organise work, on your own or as a team. Creating an account and using it is free. By signing up you accept these terms and declare that you have read the <link>privacy policy</link>.

account.heading: Your account
account.age: You must be at least 14 years old to sign up.
account.responsibility: You are responsible for what is done with your account. Use a password you do not use anywhere else, and end any sessions you do not recognise from the settings.
account.deletion: You can delete your account whenever you want from the settings.

content.heading: Your content
content.ownership: What you write and upload remains yours. We only store it and show it to the people you share each board with, so that the service works.
content.prohibitedIntro: You may not use the service to:
content.illegal: Publish illegal content or content that infringes the rights of others.
content.malware: Upload malware, or files in order to distribute them outside the service.
content.spam: Send spam or harass other people.
content.abuse: Try to access other people's accounts or boards, or deliberately overload the service.
content.enforcement: If these rules are broken, the controller may remove the content or suspend the account. Where possible, they will warn you first and explain why.

availability.heading: Availability and warranties
availability.body: The service is offered free of charge and “as is”, with no guarantee of continuous availability or of being error-free. Keep copies of what matters: you can export each board and all your data from the app. Nothing above limits the rights the law grants you as a user.

changes.heading: Changes and end of the service
changes.body: If the terms change significantly, or if the service is going to close, you will be notified reasonably in advance so that you can export your data.

software.heading: The software
software.body: orgtable is distributed under the {license} licence. You can view, download and modify the code of this instance in its <link>repository</link>, and host your own instance.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: For any questions about these terms: {contact}.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.metaDescription: What this orgtable instance stores in your browser.
cookies.intro: orgtable does not use advertising, analytics or third-party cookies. It only stores in your browser what it strictly needs to work, which does not require your consent (Article 22.2 of the Spanish LSSI). That is why you will not see a cookie banner.

duration.one: {count} day, or until you sign out
duration.other: {count} days, or until you sign out

theme.purpose: Remembering whether you prefer the light or dark theme
theme.duration: Until you delete it from your browser

cookies.outro: You can delete them all from your browser settings. Without the session cookie you will not be able to use the app with your account.

notice.title: Legal notice
notice.metaDescription: Details of who operates this orgtable instance.

purpose.heading: Purpose
purpose.body: This site offers an instance of orgtable, a Kanban board application. The terms for using it are in the <terms>terms of use</terms>, and the processing of data in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

ip.heading: Intellectual property
ip.body: The orgtable software is open source and is distributed under its own licence, linked in the footer of this page. The content of the boards belongs to whoever creates it.
